from shop.fees import late_fee, needs_approval, overdraft_allowed


def test_late_fee():
    assert late_fee(5, False) == 9


def test_member_late_fee():
    assert late_fee(6, True) == 6


def test_deposit_approval():
    assert needs_approval(150, False) and not needs_approval(50, True)


def test_overdraft():
    assert overdraft_allowed(-50, 100) and not overdraft_allowed(-150, 100)
